_about: Z28: WM → zone card-collection blobs read by the zone (dept 4 CHAR). Offsets are payload offsets; the handlers read the PROTO body at payload +6 (after the 6-byte ref). Layouts read in the 2016 zone code (cca_Load / ccb_Load / ccr_Load); names and record structs from the 2016 zone PDB (pdb2016), the 2017 client PDB agrees.

0x10e3.notes: PROTO_NC_CHAR_CARDCOLLECT_CMD after the ref; forwarded by the WM from Character 0x10E2
